title: Bob Sutton on X — 'capitalism and compassion need not be treated as trade-offs'
summary: Stanford's Bob Sutton — bestselling author of The No Asshole Rule and Good Boss, Bad Boss, who hosted Eric at Manny's SF earlier this month — publicly endorses Incorruptible on launch eve with a one-line frame that captures the book's core wager.
blockquote: Go Eric! Your book can make companies better for all us… a compelling argument that capitalism and compassion need not be treated as trade-offs.
attribution_title: Stanford professor; bestselling author, The No Asshole Rule and Good Boss, Bad Boss
